title: UI workspace pages drop legacy chrome and inert hand-rolled controls
notes: From ux-audit rescan 2026-08-23 ('UI family'). Pages: ui-autolayout, ui-build-screen, ui-grid, ui-nested, ui-prototype, ui-variants, states, typography. Key items: delete hand-authored titlebar/toolbar/.cmdk on all 8 (shell builds chrome from data-shell); DS .stepper/.slider replace .ua-stepper/.ug-stepper and typography's inert .bar meters; ui-variants .pswitch/.ptext/.prop to .switch/.input/.irow; move lesson prose off canvas HUDs (ui-autolayout .al-status, ui-grid .gc-status + in-dock teaching prose, ui-nested .linknote); drop in-dock 'In the API' codeblk duplicates; ui-prototype run panel to a dgrp or sheet; icons (ic-trash for remove, ic-arrow-right for transitions, drop unicode pilcrow). Verify 200 + audit-sweep.
